scope: Official-source feasibility review for an Ontario/Toronto exemplar only; no pilot geography has been authorized.
claim_ceiling: This registry establishes public definitions, access metadata, and testable source hypotheses. It does not establish row-level availability, lawful automated use, operating-location coverage, point-in-time completeness, predictive value, causal lift, or commercial value.

bounded_conclusion.claim: No reviewed official public source is a complete, current, named universe with one row per physical operating establishment.
bounded_conclusion.qualification: This is a bounded inference from the sources below, not proof that no such source exists.
counterevidence_considered: Statistics Canada Business Register has broad business coverage but public products are aggregate and its location unit is not necessarily a single operating establishment.
Open Database of Businesses is named and downloadable but is explicitly incomplete and based on data collected in 2022.
Municipal and provincial licence data can identify physical business locations but only for regulated categories and jurisdictions.

sources.observed_product: Public aggregate business-count tables and Business Register documentation
sources.native_grain: statistical location or enterprise aggregate, depending on product
sources.temporal_notes: Product reference periods and methodological changes must be retained; public counts do not provide candidate-level history.
disqualifiers: no public named/addressed microdata feed verified
location concept may represent a group of operating entities
sources.required_next_test: Reconcile any pilot candidate counts to the matching geography, NAICS, employment, and reference-period table.

sources.observed_product: Downloadable experimental open database assembled from public sources
sources.native_grain: named business record assembled from source websites
sources.temporal_notes: Collection occurred May through December 2022 and the release is not a reliable point-in-time history.
sources.feasible_role: exploratory candidate-recall supplement and schema prototyping
disqualifiers: publisher describes coverage as incomplete
stale for current route issuance
not the Business Register
sources.required_next_test: Hash and profile a permitted sample, quantify current-location survival against an independent adjudicated sample, and preserve retrieval/publication/effective clocks.

sources.observed_product: Interactive registry search and ordered corporation profile report
sources.native_grain: legal organization or registered business name
sources.temporal_notes: A corporation profile report reflects registry information as of its order date, not an observed operating-location event history.
disqualifiers: registered or head office can differ from operating establishment
no authorized bulk acquisition path verified
sources.required_next_test: Define a lawful per-record corroboration workflow only after an approved candidate source exists.

sources.observed_product: Downloadable select licence and registration data
sources.native_grain: licence or registration record for selected regulated categories
sources.temporal_notes: Published on a recurring cadence; record effective dates and publication/retrieval clocks require field audit.
sources.feasible_role: high-precision seed for covered regulated categories
disqualifiers: not a general business universe
category and field coverage require measurement
sources.required_next_test: Acquire an authorized immutable sample and measure unique current physical-location coverage, duplicates, closure lag, and field clocks.

sources.observed_product: Municipal business licence and permit open-data feed
sources.temporal_notes: Metadata describes frequent updates; issue, expiry, cancellation, publication, and retrieval clocks must remain distinct.
sources.feasible_role: municipal regulated-category seed and temporal event source
disqualifiers: limited to licensed categories
a licence is not proof of current operation
dataset-specific licence metadata needs confirmation
sources.required_next_test: After geography authorization, reproduce package download and audit licence status, address grain, update lag, history, and governing terms.

sources.temporal_notes: Application, issuance, revision, completion, publication, and retrieval are separate clocks.
sources.feasible_role: candidate precursor signal and property activity evidence
disqualifiers: permit applicant can differ from future occupier
permit does not establish opening or current operation
sources.required_next_test: Construct historical snapshots without future leakage and test whether permit features add out-of-time value over baselines.

sources.observed_product: Planning and committee application records plus statutory context
sources.temporal_notes: Submission, status transition, decision, appeal, public availability, and retrieval are distinct clocks.
disqualifiers: application may be refused, withdrawn, revised, or never built
future tenant usually unresolved
sources.required_next_test: Map statuses point-in-time and test downstream opening association without using post-decision information.

sources.temporal_notes: By-law version, amendment effective date, geometry version, publication, and retrieval must be retained.
disqualifiers: permitted use does not establish actual use
parcel is not suite, business, or occupier
sources.required_next_test: Measure address-to-parcel ambiguity and version-aware zoning coverage on an authorized sample.

sources.native_grain: parcel, instrument, or registered owner interest
sources.temporal_notes: Registration/event time, system availability, order, and retrieval clocks differ.
sources.feasible_role: property ownership corroboration for narrowly approved cases
disqualifiers: owner is not necessarily occupier
fees and access authority are external constraints
sources.required_next_test: Do not acquire until source envelope, cost authority, permitted use, and minimum necessary fields are approved.

sources.observed_product: Assessment and commercial property data products
sources.temporal_notes: Assessment valuation/reference dates differ from current occupation and retrieval dates.
disqualifiers: not a public business-establishment feed
access and downstream use require explicit authority
sources.required_next_test: Define a minimum-necessary licensed-data experiment only after firm authorization and terms review.

claim_evidence_graph.claim: The reviewed source set does not contain a complete current named operating-establishment universe.
evidence: all source records in this registry
claim_evidence_graph.decision_effect: Design for measured multi-source recall and abstain when ten valid locations cannot be proven.

claim_evidence_graph.claim: Legal organization, registered office, licence, permit, parcel, owner, occupier, and operating establishment are non-interchangeable grains.
evidence: source-native grains and disqualifiers in this registry
claim_evidence_graph.decision_effect: Preserve separate identifiers and evidence links; never collapse by shared address alone.

claim_evidence_graph.claim: Event/effective, public-availability, observed, and retrieval clocks must be represented separately.
evidence: registry temporal notes across permits, planning, licensing, registry, and assessment products
claim_evidence_graph.decision_effect: Require clock fields and point-in-time reconstruction in later contracts.

claim_evidence_graph.claim: Permit and planning events add prospective commercial signal beyond simpler baselines.
counterevidence: applications can fail or never build
applicant/property is not the future occupier
claim_evidence_graph.decision_effect: No scoring weight until out-of-time ablation and calibration demonstrate incremental value.

claim_evidence_graph.claim: A source is lawful and operationally approved for the pilot.
counterevidence: some products are interactive, fee-bearing, access-dependent, or have unresolved dataset-specific terms

required_followups.output: official package and field registry for every in-scope municipality
measured event/publication/retrieval clock behavior and snapshot availability
measured ambiguity, conflicts, duplicates, closure lag, and point-in-time joins

required_followups.trigger: after outcome labels reach sufficient maturity
required_followups.output: out-of-time baseline comparison, ablation, calibration, uncertainty, and negative controls

gate.non_inferable_authority: The repository cannot choose the firm's pilot geography, permitted paid sources, data handling authority, or spending authority.

independent_review.method: Independent official-source discovery and source-by-source grain/access/caveat review
